verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-hosted inference engine and serving backend. Its OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible APIs make it a provider that clients connect to, not a client interface that aggregates cloud providers alongside local models. Connecting to external cloud AI providers belongs to the client or gateway role, so this is a wrong-axis question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows vLLM proxying or routing to cloud providers, which would have made the axis apply.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface
